## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
#Path to working directory
setwd("/Users/cmdb/qb26-answers/week1")

#Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

#read in bed file
header <- c( "chr", "start", "end", "count" )
df_kc <- read_tsv( "hg19-kc-count.bed", col_names=header )

#plot with ggplot and save
unique(df_kc$chr)
csomes <- c(unique(df_kc$chr))

df_kc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=start, y=count))+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~chr, scales="free_x") +
  labs(
    x ="Position",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

ggsave( "exercise1.png", width = 14, height =8 )
```
